headline: Fisherman's Row Ignites as Dead Lands Attrition Soars
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch three hours ago, Fisherman's Row has reignited as the most fluid front, logging fresh base exchanges alongside accelerating casualty rates over the past two hours. In the Dead Lands, direct base turnover paused during the latest window, yet attritional combat has surged violently, exacting more than two thousand casualties in the recent hour alone. Linn of Mercy has likewise seen base shifts quiet after earlier turmoil, though combined losses and enlistment rates remain elevated across the contested central axis. To the west, King's Cage and Palantine Berm have sharply escalated in engagement tempo, reflecting heightened skirmishing along their fortified borders. Weathered Expanse continues to absorb massive casualties despite completely frozen territorial lines, while earlier hotspots across Lykos Isle, Stlican Shelf, and Stonecradle have settled into lower-tempo holding actions without new territorial changes.
